name: GPT-4o Mini
description: Small, affordable model for lightweight tasks with strong performance.
longDescription: GPT-4o Mini is a cost-efficient small model optimized for fast, lightweight tasks. It scores 82% on MMLU and currently outperforms GPT-4 on chat preferences in LMSYS leaderboard. It supports text and vision inputs with text outputs.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
